groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.549% and the 10Y at 4.864%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -4.98% over five sessions and -7.90% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -5.71% at about $92.71, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+2/100, 65% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, healthy market breadth, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

The key confirmation remains the interaction between Treasury yields and semiconductor leadership. A sustained 10Y break above roughly 5.00–5.05% alongside weakening chips would materially weaken the setup; easing yields with stronger semiconductor participation would improve it.
